summary: `modal_app.py` installs `torch>=2.4` from `https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu121` *before* `pip_install_from_pyproject`. Reason: default PyPI torch wheel can resolve to the CPU variant on Linux x86_64; our `_detect_device()` would silently fall through CUDA → MPS → CPU and we'd benchmark CPU on a GPU host without noticing. Explicit pin = guaranteed GPU torch + loud failure if the base image's CUDA version drifts from cu121. Trade-off: if Modal moves to a non-CUDA-12 base, we bump the URL.
title: Modal image pins CUDA torch wheel explicitly
